_comment: STRATEGY TEMPLATE - ALL POSSIBLE FIELDS DOCUMENTED
This is a REFERENCE template showing every field available
Copy this file and remove fields you don't need (set to null)
name: Template Strategy Name
description: Detailed description of what this strategy does and why
_enabled: true = active, false = skip this strategy

filters._comment: All filters are OPTIONAL (use null to disable)
filters._categories_WARNING: ⚠️ KALSHI API DOES NOT SEND CATEGORY DATA - IT'S ALWAYS EMPTY!
filters._categories_DO_NOT_USE: DO NOT USE THIS FIELD! Use series_ticker instead!
filters._categories_note: This field exists but Kalshi never populates it. Always set to null.
filters._exclude_WARNING: ⚠️ DOES NOT WORK - Kalshi doesn't send category data!
filters._exclude_note: Always set to null. Use series_ticker to filter instead.
filters._series_IMPORTANT: ✅ USE THIS TO FILTER BY SPORT/TYPE - THIS ACTUALLY WORKS!
filters._series_note: Kalshi series tickers. If null, fetches all markets. If specified, ONLY fetches from these series.
filters._series_examples: KXNBAGAME (NBA), KXNFLGAME (NFL), KXNHLGAME (NHL), KXMLBGAME (MLB), KXWEATHER (weather), KXPOLITICS (politics)
filters._min_price_note: Minimum price in dollars (0.00 to 1.00). Market must be >= this price. Example: 0.10 = only markets priced at 10¢ or higher.
filters._max_price_note: Maximum price in dollars (0.00 to 1.00). Market must be <= this price. Example: 0.90 = only markets priced at 90¢ or lower.
filters._min_volume_note: Minimum total volume (contracts traded). Higher = more liquid. Example: 1000 = reject if fewer than 1000 contracts traded total.
filters._min_open_interest_note: Minimum open interest (outstanding contracts). Higher = more active. Example: 500 = reject if fewer than 500 contracts currently open.
filters._min_time_note: Minimum time until event resolution (minutes). Example: 60 = reject events resolving in less than 1 hour.
filters._max_time_note: Maximum time until event resolution (minutes). Example: 1440 = reject events resolving in more than 24 hours.
filters._momentum_pct_note: Minimum price change % in lookback period. Example: 5.0 = price must have moved at least 5% in the lookback window. Requires momentum_lookback_minutes.
filters._momentum_lookback_note: How far back to measure momentum (minutes). Example: 60 = check price change over last hour. Requires min_momentum_pct.
filters._volume_spike_pct_note: Minimum volume spike % required. Detects sharp money entering. Example: 50.0 = volume rate must be 50% above average in lookback window. Requires volume_spike_lookback_minutes.
filters._volume_spike_lookback_note: How far back to measure volume spike (minutes). Example: 10 = check volume spike over last 10 minutes. Requires min_volume_spike_pct.
filters._order_flow_imbalance_note: Minimum order flow imbalance (OFI) required. Measures buy/sell pressure. Range 0.0-1.0 (absolute value).
filters._prioritize_live_note: Enable LIVE game prioritization. If true, markets expiring <2h with >30% recent volume are evaluated FIRST.
filters._prioritize_criteria: LIVE = time_to_event < 2h AND volume_24h/volume > 0.30 AND volume > 1000
filters._prioritize_example: NBA game in 4th quarter (ending in 1h) = LIVE, game starting in 3 hours = non-LIVE
filters._prioritize_rationale: Sports games last 2-3h. If ending in <2h, game is actively being played.
filters._spread_note: Maximum bid-ask spread in cents. Example: 0.05 = reject if spread > 5¢. Ensures tight orderbook.
filters._best_price_qty_note: Minimum contracts available at best price. Example: 50 = reject if fewer than 50 contracts available at current best price. Ensures depth.

entry_rules._side_options: Yes = always buy YES, No = always buy NO, CheaperSide = buy whichever is < 50¢, ExpensiveSide = buy whichever is > 50¢, Both = trade both sides

_side_examples.Yes: Always bet YES regardless of price
_side_examples.No: Always bet NO regardless of price

entry_rules._position_size_note: Amount to trade. Meaning depends on position_size_unit.
entry_rules._unit_options: Contracts = fixed number of contracts (e.g., 100 contracts), Dollars = dollar amount including fees (e.g., $100 total investment)
entry_rules._unit_example_contracts: position_size: 100, unit: Contracts = buy exactly 100 contracts
entry_rules._unit_example_dollars: position_size: 100, unit: Dollars = spend $100 total (contracts calculated based on price)
entry_rules._order_type_options: Market = immediate execution (pays taker fee ~3%), Limit = wait for price (pays maker fee ~0.5%)
entry_rules._order_type_tradeoff: Market = fast but expensive, Limit = cheap but might not fill
entry_rules._limit_offset_note: Only used if order_type = Limit. Offset from current price in dollars.

_limit_offset_examples.negative: -0.01 = bid 1¢ BELOW current price (more likely to get maker fee, less likely to fill immediately)
_limit_offset_examples.zero: 0.00 = bid at current price (might get maker or taker fee depending on timing)
_limit_offset_examples.positive: 0.01 = bid 1¢ ABOVE current price (more likely to fill immediately, might pay taker fee)

exit_rules._comment: All percentages are relative to ENTRY PRICE
exit_rules._take_profit_note: Exit when profit reaches this % of entry price. Example: Bought at 50¢, take_profit 20% = exit when price hits 60¢ (10¢ profit = 20% of 50¢).
exit_rules._stop_loss_note: Exit when loss reaches this % of entry price. Example: Bought at 50¢, stop_loss 30% = exit when price drops to 35¢ (15¢ loss = 30% of 50¢).
exit_rules._trailing_note: Distance from peak price before triggering exit. Only activates after trailing_stop_activation_pct is hit.
exit_rules._trailing_example: Peak price 80¢, trailing 5% = exit if price drops to 76¢ (4¢ drop from peak).
exit_rules._trailing_activation_note: Profit % required before trailing stop activates. Example: 10% = trailing only starts after 10% profit is reached.
exit_rules._trailing_full_example: Buy at 50¢. Hits 55¢ (10% profit) → trailing activates. Peak 60¢. If drops to 57¢ (5% from peak) → exit.
exit_rules._max_hold_note: Maximum time to hold position (minutes). Force exit after this time regardless of P&L. Example: 1440 = force exit after 24 hours.
exit_rules._exit_order_note: Market = immediate exit (pays taker fee), Limit = wait for price (pays maker fee). Usually Market for exits (guarantee execution).

risk_limits._concurrent_note: Maximum number of positions open at same time. Example: 5 = stop opening new positions when 5 are already open.
risk_limits._daily_loss_note: Maximum total loss per day in USD. Example: $100 = stop trading for the day if total losses reach $100.
risk_limits._position_loss_note: Maximum loss for single position in USD. Hard stop per position. Example: $50 = force close position if loss exceeds $50 (overrides stop_loss_pct).
risk_limits._cooldown_note: Minutes to wait after hitting max_daily_loss before resuming trading. Example: 60 = wait 1 hour after hitting daily loss limit before opening new positions.

_field_count: TOTAL FIELDS: 38 (6 metadata + 15 filters + 5 entry + 8 exit + 4 risk)
_required_fields: id, name, description, version, enabled, filters, entry_rules, exit_rules, risk_limits
_all_other_fields: Optional - set to null if not needed
